name: quit-crash-d3d12
note: The D3D12 fault while the player quits. Fixed in 4a61ee3 (the game ends itself on quit); on a build with that commit it is a regression and is filed. -clean-quit brings it back on purpose, so the bot never passes it.

name: spell-aim-markers
note: Not a bug: small flat cream (pale yellow, glowing) squares, one per cell, on the cells the selected spell will hit. They are the spell aim markers (SpellCaster.ShowMarkers, since 2026-10-24) and follow the crosshair while a spell is selected, which the bot leaves selected after every radial cast. Triage filed them as cracked ground in 0.1.8 (F-0006, #2). Crack webs are thin dark lines on glass, ice, panes and frozen raiders, not squares.
